text: Hey Allie — can I ask you a small favour? Things between me and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and honestly right now I'd rather not see her outside of work. I'm not trying to make it a thing, I just need some space for a while. So if you're planning anything with both of us — dinner, drinks, study sessions — could you keep us apart for now? Would rather you didn't put us in the same room until things settle. Thanks for understanding. 🙂

Hey Jordan — of course, no explanation needed. For anything I organise, I'll keep it to one of you at a time and not put you both in the same room for now. I won't say anything to Sarah about this either; it's yours, not mine to pass on.

The only thing I can't promise is department events themselves — lectures, seminars, office meetings — those are fixed and open to everyone. But dinners, drinks, study sessions, anything that's mine to arrange: consider it handled.
Thanks, Allie — that's exactly what I meant. Department events are fine, of course; I just wanted to keep the social stuff separate for now. And thanks for keeping it between us. 🙂

Hey Allie! Hope your week's going okay. Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I think it'd be fun — and it'd be nice if Jordan came too, if you feel like inviting him. Just something small and easy.

Hey Sarah — week's fine, thanks! A get-together at my place sounds nice, and Saturday 3:30 works for me, so let's put it down.

One thing though: I'd rather keep it just us this time — I've got some stuff on my plate and small and easy is exactly what I need right now. Hope that's okay! You're welcome to bring anyone else, or we can do a bigger one another weekend.

One small thing — when you invite him, could you leave me out of it? Like it's just your own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between Jordan and me lately and I'd rather he didn't feel it's about me.
Totally okay — no pressure at all, and honestly a small one sounds good. Saturday 3:30 at yours it is, I'll put it down. Thanks for hosting!

Ah, that part I'd rather not do. Inviting Jordan and making it sound like my own idea — with you quietly behind it — means setting it up on something I can't be straight with him about, and if he found out it came from you it would land worse than just asking him yourself. I don't want to be in the middle of that.

So: Saturday 3:30 at mine is still on, and it stays just us — that's the part I can honestly do. If you two want to sort things out, that's better said to him directly; I'm happy to hang out with Jordan another time separately, and I won't carry anything either way between you.
Perfect — Saturday 3:30 at mine then. I've got it down. See you then! 🙂

Fair enough — I won't put you in that spot. Sorry for asking.

So: Saturday 3:30 at yours, just us. I've got it down and I'm looking forward to it. Thanks, Allie.
No need to apologise. Saturday 3:30 — looking forward to it too. 🙂
